conflicts.remarks_quote: This method requires that the feature to be selected.
conflicts.example_quote:
swModel.ClearSelection2 True
    ' Set the property values for the selected feature
    swModel.SelectedFeatureProperties 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, "Thicken1"
conflicts.why: Remarks 说调用前必须已选中特征；示例却先 ClearSelection2 清空选区，紧接着把 FeatureName 传成 Thicken1 调用。

conflicts.remarks_quote: To select the feature programmatically, you can use [[IModelDocExtension::SelectByID2]] and pass in the feature name and the appropriate object type (for example, "BODYFEATURE", "ATTRIBUTE", "PLANE", "SKETCH", and so on) and the selection coordinates 0,0,0.
conflicts.why: Remarks 指定用 SelectByID2 按特征名+类型选中；示例全程无 SelectByID2，直接把名字当最后一个实参传进去。

example_more_specific.what: 示例把 RgbColor 与 Ambient/Diffuse/Specular/Shininess/Transparency/Emission 全传 0，只靠末位 FeatureName 改名。

conflicts.remarks_quote: [[ISelectionMgr]] objects are transient because they are invalid as soon as another selection is made. So, do not hold on to these pointers for any length of time.
conflicts.example_quote:
Set swSelMgr = swModel.SelectionManager
    bRet = swModel.Extension.SelectByID2("Rip1", "BODYFEATURE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Set swFeat = swSelMgr.GetSelectedObject6(1, -1)
conflicts.why: 指针在任何选择之前取得，中间跨过 3 次 SelectByID2 才使用；C# 与 VB.NET 两份同型。

conflicts.remarks_quote: [[ISelectionMgr]] objects are transient because they are invalid as soon as another selection is made. So, do not hold on to these pointers for any length of time.
conflicts.example_quote:
Set swSelMgr = modDoc.SelectionManager
    Set segments(0) = swSelMgr.GetSelectedObject6(1, 0)
    Set segments(5) = swSelMgr.GetSelectedObject6(6, 0)
conflicts.why: 指针在尚未做任何选择时取走，其后连续 6 次 SelectByID2，再回头用它取 6 个路径段。

example_more_specific.what: 示例给出 GetSelectedObject6 的具体实参形态 (1, -1) 取当前选中特征；成员页只说指针会失效，未给调用序。
